name: ℵ Central Station
description: Watch Alephium in real time as a pixel-art train station. Every block is a train and every transaction is a passenger who boards it. The 4 platforms are Alephium’s 4 groups. Spot whales, token carriers and contract calls, follow the miner on every train, and click any passenger or train to open it in the explorer. Search a tx hash or address to find your own passenger. Live data comes from a full-node WebSocket, and there’s also a neon metro map view.”
short_description: Alephium live as a pixel-art train station
